opts: A) Verb tense should be past perfect

conflicts.why: Captures the main finding that a fungus may reduce ocean plastic
conflicts.q:
Passage: "Researchers discovered that a certain fungus can degrade plastic in seawater within weeks, offering a potential solution to marine pollution. The study, conducted over two years, showed a 70% reduction in micro‑plastic particles in test tanks." Which sentence best summarizes the passage?
A) The fungus was harmful to marine life.
B) Plastic cannot be broken down in seawater.
C) A fungus may help reduce plastic pollution in oceans.
D) The study lasted only a few months.
opts: A) The fungus was harmful to marine life.
B) A fungus may help reduce plastic pollution in oceans.
C) The study lasted only a few months.
D) Plastic cannot be broken down in seawater.
